non_arbitrary_lever_search.reason: 44/123 origins show EBR as net-beneficial in the realized closed loop, 77/123 show it as net-costly with no realized benefit; distinguishing these in advance (non-hindsight) was not achieved with any existing governed quantity.
non_arbitrary_lever_search.label: DERIVED

final_answer_to_central_question.breakdown: Not primarily forecast-error-driven (tested case shows ~zero forecast error); genuinely mixed between necessary forward protection (~44/123 origins) and conservatively-unused reserve (~77/123 origins) in this specific 2025 holdout population; critical-service impact of full removal is negligible (-0.0016pp R_CF) while non-critical service absorbs most of the realized cost of removal (+0.0663pp R_P degradation).

classification_meaning: EBR driver confirmed, but no safe parameter-free lever exists
